name: Code as Policies
summary: Rather than selecting from a skill list, the LLM writes executable code that calls perception and control APIs, recursively defining helper functions as needed. This gives the planner real expressive power: feedback loops, conditional logic, spatial arithmetic ('put the block 10 cm to the left'), and generalization to instructions no skill vocabulary anticipated.
innovation: Programs as the policy representation, providing composition and control flow for free.
Recursive function generation letting the model define undefined helpers on demand.
matters: The template for LLM-as-orchestrator systems, including reward writers such as Eureka.
limits: Only as good as the underlying perception and control APIs; generated code fails silently and unsafely.
lineage: SayCan's LLM planner upgraded from skill selection to program synthesis.
